title: Delivery service selection (auto-set S+C flags)
description: Application layer automatically selects delivery service per traffic type. IM and SOS: set DTN S+C flags, use CoAP CON (message service). Telemetry, position, sensor: no DTN flags, use CoAP NON (datagram service). Broadcast messages (ff02::1): always datagram. Spec: 12-apps.md §18.1.2 delivery service selection, 07-transport-app.md §10.2 delivery services table. All three impls.
